role: Process-wide, lock-protected, in-memory LRU cache (32 entries) of AnalysisSummaryGenerator summaries keyed by (session UUID, fingerprint), so a summary is only handed back for the inputs it was generated from and summaries of one session for different readers (screen language vs the assistant's English) coexist.
types: AnalysisSummaryCache: final class (Sendable) — LRU summary cache keyed by session and fingerprint
AnalysisSummaryCache.State: struct — entries [Key: AnalysisSummary] and order [Key] (least recently used first), with touch(_:)
toplevel: static let shared; private static maxEntries 32; private Key and State types; state lock initialised with empty State.

units.does: Moves key to the end of `order` (most recently used): removes any existing occurrence, then appends it.
Private no-op initializer for the singleton.

Hashes NarrativeLanguage.isEnglish, app locale id, session recoveryScore, frozenReadiness, tags, analysisResult date/rmssd/meanHR, sleep start/end ms, sleep minutes, respiratory rate and SpO2 into an Int fingerprint (per-process Hasher seed).

Hashes fingerprint(for: session) together with the caller's `inputs` hash (generator inputs that do not live on the session) into one Int, so a cache entry stored with it misses once any of those inputs changes.

Under the lock: stores summary under Key(id, fingerprint) (default fingerprint 0), marks the key most recently used (touch), then evicts least-recently-used keys from the front of `order` until at most 32 entries remain. Other fingerprints of the same session are kept.

branches.effect: remove the least recently used key and its entry; loop until within bound; false: done

units.does: Under the lock: returns the summary stored under exactly Key(id, fingerprint) and marks it most recently used; nil when there is none (the caller regenerates).

branches.effect: return nil; else touch the key and return the summary

units.does: Under the lock: empties entries and order.
